headline: Molloy and St. Thomas Aquinas top the table unbeaten
dek: The pair drew goalless with each other at St. Thomas Aquinas and have won every other conference match they have played, Molloy at D'Youville and St. Thomas Aquinas at District of Columbia on the latest day. Molloy have conceded five goals all season and lost once, at home to Assumption in September.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Queens have scored 25 goals, more than any other programme, and conceded nine; only the defeat at Holy Family and the home defeat to Staten Island have cost them.

wire.line: Queens' first home defeat of the season came against Staten Island, the first match in which they have failed to score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match is past its date with no result published: District of Columbia's opening-day trip to Shepherd.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Daemen have conceded 32 goals, more than any other programme; the home defeat to Mercy came in their first match since the win at Roberts Wesleyan.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lorenzo Herrera has made 50 saves for District of Columbia and conceded ten; the home defeat to St. Thomas Aquinas was the side's fourth.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jacob Darwesh Lund-Iversen has scored ten of Mercy's eighteen goals from 28 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Anthony Martinez has made 24 saves and conceded three goals for Molloy, who have conceded five all season.

last_match.line: D'Youville had not lost at home this season before Molloy's visit; their other defeats all came on the road.

next_match.line: Molloy have not lost away from home this season; American International have already beaten D'Youville and lost at Mercy.
